doc: State-machine driver for an object embedded 0x20 bytes into a larger allocation (entity struct). Reacts to global flag bits in D_80083160 (offsets 0x8/0x10): bit 0x20 of field10 tears down/resets via func_80050DA8 on the nested sub-object at a0-0x20; bit 0x40 of field10 re-derives the entity's unk20 slot via func_800502E0 and either (func_8004FF20 not-ready) swaps in func_8004FFA8 as the entity's active callback (unk_neg0x10), saving the previous callback into unk04, or (ready) hands off to func_80050EA8; otherwise if field8 has bit 0x5000 set, derives a ramp direction s1 (+-1/0) from field10's 0x4000/0x1000 bits, or (failing that) from a saturating counter at unk0C that re-checks field8 directly once it saturates, and once a nonzero direction is established re-wraps the index field (unk1C) via func_80049DE8, saving the old value to unk18. Always finishes by forwarding to func_800500B4(entity->unk68, entity).
